scoring.rule: Only PASS earns points. BLOCKED remains 0 until the criterion's own required evidence exists.

criteria.blocker: No target-farmer 5–10 second open-recall evidence exists for the public hero.
criteria.closure_action: Run WWW-000 with 9–12 target farmers; record open recall, material misclassifications and the surviving public message.

criteria.blocker: CTA/form mechanics are proven, but the criterion also requires target-farmer evidence that the next action is understood.
criteria.closure_action: Add next-action comprehension to WWW-000 and record the result.

criteria.blocker: The calibrated example has statistical plausibility evidence but no Market-A human domain/economic sign-off.
criteria.closure_action: Have a Finnish/Market-A crop-economics reviewer validate values, units, allocation interpretation and terminology; record reviewer/date/conclusion.

criteria.blocker: The privacy notice still lacks controller/contact facts, actual processors/transfers/security facts, jurisdiction-specific rights/complaint wording and formal legal approval.
criteria.closure_action: Resolve all bracketed facts in the privacy template, perform controller-specific legal review, publish the approved notice and link it at collection time.

criteria.blocker: Farm-data defaults are decided but final terms still lack actual infrastructure/processors/security responsibilities and formal contractual/legal approval.
criteria.closure_action: Resolve infrastructure facts, complete contractual wording, obtain legal approval and make terms available before any farm records are requested.

criteria.blocker: A final legal/engineering claim audit cannot pass until production providers, security controls and approved policy text are known.
criteria.closure_action: At release candidate, compare every privacy/security claim against deployed providers, implemented controls and approved legal text; record sign-off.

criteria.blocker: Legal company identity and required publication details are not confirmed in the repository.
criteria.closure_action: Provide authoritative legal entity name, registration/business ID, jurisdiction and required registered/public address/contact facts; cross-check against the official registry.

criteria.blocker: Pilot replies have an owner, but a confirmed public direct-contact path for investors/partners/general enquiries is not available.
criteria.closure_action: Configure a monitored direct-contact address/path, publish it and perform a send/receive smoke test.

criteria.blocker: Team capability copy exists, but each published member has not supplied explicit final wording/profile/photo consent.
criteria.closure_action: Obtain one recorded confirmation per member covering name, role, expertise wording, links, photo use and permission to publish.

criteria.blocker: B2 has internal/red-team evidence but no completed target-farmer art-direction validation.
criteria.closure_action: Run the canonical B2 farmer test; record comprehension, trust and dashboard/accounting/GIS misclassification patterns against kill criteria.

criteria.blocker: Production form delivery is intentionally disabled until privacy-notice and company-details gates are READY.
criteria.closure_action: After privacy/company gates close, configure the production endpoint, verify server-side validation/delivery/failure behavior and perform an end-to-end delivery smoke test.

criteria.blocker: Automated keyboard coverage exists, but the contract explicitly requires a manual keyboard/focus and representative screen-reader sign-off.
criteria.closure_action: Run the final release SHA using keyboard only and at least one representative screen reader; record route/interaction results and defects.

criteria.blocker: Responsive widths are automated, but required manual 200%/400% zoom and WCAG reflow sign-off is not recorded.
criteria.closure_action: Audit critical routes at required zoom/reflow settings on the release candidate and record pass/fail evidence.

criteria.blocker: No statistically meaningful production RUM exists yet; the contract keeps CWV provisional until RUM closes it.
criteria.closure_action: Deploy the release candidate, collect sufficient mobile/desktop RUM and verify LCP ≤2.5s, INP ≤200ms and CLS ≤0.1 at p75; retain a production-equivalent lab audit before enough RUM exists.

criteria.blocker: Final image/font network audit cannot be completed before the real documentary asset and production deployment exist.
criteria.closure_action: After real assets are installed, audit formats/srcset/dimensions/loading priority/font payload/preloads and production waterfall.
Close every release gate with its required evidence; do not override the gate mechanism.

criteria.blocker: SEO/crawl infrastructure is implemented but cannot be verified on the actual production origin until the release candidate is deployed with a confirmed canonical domain.
criteria.closure_action: Configure the canonical production SITE_URL, deploy the candidate, then verify canonical URLs, robots, sitemap, metadata and route status codes from the live origin.

criteria.blocker: Pilot ownership exists, but website availability/privacy-request monitoring and final delivery/incident ownership are not fully operationalized.
criteria.closure_action: Name owners for site availability, privacy requests and critical incidents; configure monitoring/notifications and perform delivery/alert smoke tests.
